title: John Chrysostom on Wisdom of Solomon 4:8
body: “I say not these things as accusing the old, but the young. For in my judgment they who act thus even if they have come to their hundredth year, are young; just as the young if they be but little children, yet if they are sober-minded, are better than the old.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews

title: John Chrysostom on Wisdom of Solomon 9:14
body: “And I know indeed that what now has been said cannot by many be comprehended, and therefore it is that in many places we avoid agitating questions of human reasonings, because the rest of the people cannot follow such arguments, and if they could, still they have nothing firm or sure in them. "For the thoughts of mortal men are miserable, and our devices are but uncertain." ( Wisd.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews

title: John Chrysostom on Wisdom of Solomon 19:20
body: “So great a good is Faith. And when we fall into perplexity, then are we delivered, even though we come to death itself, even though our condition be desperate.”
author: John Chrysostom, Homilies on John and Hebrews
